pfq.sample.q: Can I test a sample before committing to a full order?
pfq.sample.a: Yes. Samples of standard references are available for evaluation on request; sample availability and freight terms are confirmed with your quotation.
pfq.lead.q: How far ahead should I place a production order?
pfq.lead.a: Lead time starts from the date the quotation is confirmed in writing and depends on the size, grit and packaging ordered. Stock references ship fastest.
pfq.beltSize.q: Can abrasive belts be supplied in a non-standard size or length?
pfq.beltSize.a: Belt width and length beyond the documented sizes are quoted case by case; converting to a custom size affects both lead time and minimum order quantity.
pfq.beltJoint.q: What belt joint and edge construction do these belts use?
pfq.beltJoint.a: Joint type and edge treatment are specified per reference. State the machine, load and finish required so the right construction is confirmed in the quotation.
pfq.discBacking.q: How do I choose between hook & loop, PSA and mesh discs?
pfq.discBacking.a: Hook & loop suits frequent grit changes, PSA suits flat pads and long run times, and mesh discs suit dust extraction. Our selection guide compares the three side by side.
pfq.discDust.q: Are these discs compatible with dust extraction?
pfq.discDust.a: Mesh and perforated discs are designed for extraction; solid discs can be supplied perforated on request. State your extraction setup and the pad you are running.
pfq.hookLoop.q: Will hook & loop discs fit my existing backup pad?
pfq.hookLoop.a: Diameter and hole pattern must match the pad. Confirm your sander model and pad diameter with the enquiry so the right disc is quoted.
pfq.psa.q: Do PSA discs work with any backup pad?
pfq.psa.a: PSA discs need a flat, clean rubber pad of the matching diameter. Confirm pad diameter and machine model with your quotation request.
pfq.mesh.q: How long does a mesh abrasive disc last?
pfq.mesh.a: Mesh discs resist loading in dust-heavy work, which usually extends useful life compared with solid paper discs. Actual life depends on material, pressure and grit.
pfq.solid.q: Can solid discs be supplied perforated for dust extraction?
pfq.solid.a: Yes — perforation pattern is agreed with the quotation. State the pad and extraction setup so the correct pattern is quoted.
